ns2:course.label: Ind Study and Special Topics
ns2:course.description: Special projects in research or creative investigation taught on an individual or class basis. 1 to 4 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Dance and consent of instructor.
